title: 第23章 宗门大典
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
“今天就是宗门大典的日子了。”

    第二天一早天还没完亮，然而外门的广场上就已经聚集了黑压压的一大片弟子。

    外门弟子们站在一起交头接耳的议论着，每个人的脸上都带着期待和紧张的表情。

    “听说今年的宗门大典跟往年不一样，只要能在比试中技压群雄就有机会晋级内门。”

    “真的假的，晋级内门那不是只有每年的考核才能定的吗。”

    “是真的我亲耳听长老说的，今年名额比往年多好几个。”

    “那还等什么，今天一定要好好表现争取晋级内门。”

    这些弟子们议论纷纷声音响起，整个广场上都充满了各种杂乱的说话声。

    忽然露出笑容的陆云站在人群的前面，双手负在身后脸上带着自信的笑容。

    旁边的几个跟班围在他身边一个个都在拍马屁，说的话一个比一个好听。

    “陆云师兄今天您肯定能晋级内门，金丹大圆满的修为在外门谁能跟您比。”

    “就是就是，陆云师兄早就该晋级内门了只是名额有限一直拖着罢了。”

    “今年名额多了陆云师兄肯定没问题，到时候进了内门可别忘了提携提携师弟们。”

    当陆云听着这些话以后也是嘴角微微上扬，他在心里想着这些人说的倒是不错。

    以他金丹大圆满的修为早就有资格晋级内门了，只是一直没有名额才拖到了现在。

    今年宗门大典他一定要抓住这个机会，进了内门之后他的地位就不一样了。

    “哥。”陆瑶从人群中挤了过来走到陆云身边，她的脸上也带着笑容。

    “瑶瑶你也来了。”

    “这么大的日子我能不来吗，哥你今天一定要晋级内门让那些不长眼的人看看你的本事。”

    只见陆云点了点头眼中闪过一丝寒意，他在心里想着等他进了内门有了权力第一件事就是收拾陈默。

    “晋级内门之后我就有话语权了，到时候想收拾谁就收拾谁谁也拦不住我。”

    “哥你说的对，那个陈默上次害得我打扫外门一个月这个仇我一定要报。”

    “你放心等我进了内门第一件事就是弄死那个陈默，让他知道得罪我们兄妹的下场。”

    当陆瑶听到这话之后脸上露出了笑容，她在心里想着陈默你等着吧等我哥进了内门你就死定了。

    “哥你一定可以的。”陆瑶说道。

    此时陆云没有继续说话而是看着前方的擂台，他的眼神中充满了决心和杀意。

    与此同时广场的另一边陈默和周玄也来到了这里，周玄看着周围密密麻麻的人群忍不住感叹了一声。
content_en:
"Today is the day of the sect's grand ceremony."

    The next morning, it was still dark, but a large, dark crowd of disciples had already gathered in the square outside the outer gate.

    The outer disciples stood together and whispered to each other, with expectations and nervous expressions on everyone's faces.

    "I heard that this year's sect ceremony is different from previous years. As long as you can surpass the others in the competition, you will have a chance to advance to the inner sect."

    "Really or not, promotion to the inner sect can only be determined through annual assessments, right?"

    "It's true. I heard what the elders said with my own ears. There are several more places this year than in previous years."

    "Then what are you waiting for? You must perform well today and strive to advance to the inner gate."

    These disciples started talking loudly, and the whole square was filled with all kinds of chaotic voices.

    Lu Yun, who suddenly smiled, stood in front of the crowd, with his hands behind his back and a confident smile on his face.

    Several followers gathered around him, all of them flattering him, and each one said something nicer than the last.

    "Senior Brother Lu Yun, you will definitely be promoted to the inner sect today. Who can compete with you in the outer sect in terms of your Golden Elixir Dzogchen cultivation?"

    "That's right, senior brother Lu Yun should have been promoted to the inner sect long ago, but the number of places is limited and it has been delayed."

    "Senior Brother Lu Yun will definitely have no problem if there are more places this year. When the time comes, don't forget to support the junior brothers when you enter the inner gate."

    When Lu Yun heard these words, the corners of his mouth raised slightly, thinking in his heart that what these people said was quite good.

    With his Golden Core Perfection cultivation, he has long been qualified to advance to the inner sect, but he has been delayed until now because he has not been able to get a spot.

    He must seize this opportunity during the sect's grand ceremony this year. His status will be different after entering the inner sect.

    "Brother." Lu Yao squeezed through the crowd and walked to Lu Yun, with a smile on her face.

    "Yao Yao, you are here too."

    "Can I not come to such an important day? Brother, you must advance to the inner sect today to let those who are not discerning see what you are capable of."

    Lu Yun nodded and a chill flashed in his eyes. He thought in his heart that when he entered the inner gate and gained power, the first thing he would do was to deal with Chen Mo.

    "After I advance to the inner sect, I will have the right to speak. I can deal with whoever I want and no one can stop me."

    "Brother, you are right. I must avenge Chen Mo who made me clean the outer door for a month last time."

    "Don't worry, the first thing I will do when I enter the inner gate is to kill that Chen Mo and let him know the consequences of offending our brothers and sisters."

    When Lu Yao heard this, a smile appeared on her face. She thought to herself, Chen Mo, just wait. You will be dead when my brother enters the inner door.

    "Brother, you can definitely do it." Lu Yao said.

    At this time, Lu Yun did not continue to speak but looked at the ring in front of him, his eyes full of determination and killing intent.

    At the same time, Chen Mo and Zhou Xuan also arrived on the other side of the square. Zhou Xuan couldn't help but sigh when he looked at the dense crowd around him.
